verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said:

verses.he: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Dominion and fear are with Him; He maketh peace in His high places.

verses.he: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל־מִ֝֗י לֹא־יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Is there any number of His armies? And upon whom doth not His light arise?

verses.he: וּמַה־יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־אֵ֑ל וּמַה־יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.en: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

verses.he: הֵ֣ן עַד־יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.en: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in His sight;
How much less man, that is a worm! And the son of man, that is a maggot!
